human_study.evidence: Human YF-17D vaccine recipients are described.

transcriptomics_available.evidence: PBMC expression profiling is available as GSE13485.

eif2ak4_measurable.evidence: EIF2AK4 day-7 expression appears in predictive signatures.

quantitative_cd8_response_available.evidence: The study measured activated CD8+ T-cell responses and related them to early expression.

appropriate_timepoints.evidence: Early day-3/day-7 expression was related to later day-15 CD8 response.

participant_level_linkage.evidence: The primary analysis correlates individual-level expression with later CD8 response.

predictor_data_accessible.evidence: Expression data are public in GEO.

outcome_data_accessible.evidence: Participant-level CD8 outcome values have not yet been located in an accessible machine-readable source.
